entities.name: Andreas von Mirbach
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Andreas Baron von Mirbach was a West German lieutenant colonel in the Bundeswehr and defense attaché at the German Embassy in Stockholm. There he was murdered by Red Army Faction terrorists who were raiding the embassy during the West German Embassy siege in Stockholm.
